concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 ('The proportion of song recordings successfully matched with climate data is measured against the total number of recordings') is not addressed by any task in the plan. Phase 0 tasks cover data download, checksum, schema validation, and optional CRS reprojection, but no task computes or reports the match rate between song records and climate data.
